concept: A hushed small-hours observatory garden for the calm, clear stretch of night after the rest of the world has gone quiet.
floor: One broad continuous midnight-teal study carpet across the full top face, with smooth softly beveled shading and no fibers, constellations, stars, border, medallion, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One compact open-front observatory-study at the rear with a broad crescent-shaped indigo roof, one large moon window, and a simple built-in reading desk.
rear_props: one broad blank star-chart desk with two oversized closed books
side_props: one chunky midnight-blue reading chair and one large closed book stack on the upper-left edge
one broad brass telescope and two rounded moonflower shrubs on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous smooth deep-indigo garden wall with broad moonstone cap blocks

materials: a few broad warm moonstone blocks

lighting: soft luminous midnight-blue ambient light with one broad moon-window glow and two warm crescent-lantern pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open study carpet
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature or egg baked into the bitmap
center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, text, watermark, external shadow
readable charts, star specks, fairy lights, tiny flowers, grass blades, pebbles, cracks, specks, or dense clutter
